claims.label: Tip email hypothesizes "sniffer pooch" is French calque
claims.claim: A viewer email to Candace's tip line argues that the phrase "pooch" with "bad sniffer" reflects a French calque ("reneneur" / "chien renifleur"), suggesting the Tyler Robinson text messages were translated from French.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain forensic linguistic analysis comparing disputed phrases to French idiomatic constructions and confirming or refuting translation-source hypothesis.

claims.label: Host concurs with French-translation hypothesis
claims.claim: Host concurs with the tip-line hypothesis that the texts were translated from French, citing "pooch" as the strongest example of non-native-English phrasing.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare full text-message corpus for additional French calques; identify likely French-speaker demographics.

claims.label: Andrew Wilson claims to have offered $300K for debate
claims.claim: On the Joe Rogan Experience, Andrew Wilson stated he offered Candace Owens $300,000 to debate him regarding the Charlie Kirk case.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify funding source of the $300K offer; obtain any formal documentation or PR communications.

claims.label: Andrew Wilson claims he hugged Erica Kirk at TPUSA HQ
claims.claim: On the Joe Rogan Experience, Andrew Wilson stated that during a visit to TPUSA HQ he spoke briefly with Erica Kirk and hugged her, expressing sympathy for her loss.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify TPUSA HQ visit through visitor logs, Erica Kirk's public statements, and corroborating witnesses.

claims.label: Andrew Wilson claims Candace has produced no evidence of conspiracy
claims.claim: On the Joe Rogan Experience, Andrew Wilson stated that Candace Owens has never presented a single shred of evidence for her theory that Israel/TPUSA/Erica Kirk conspired in Charlie Kirk's death, and that the position evolved after Erica Kirk publicly called for the conspiracy talk to stop.
claims.investigative_direction: Catalogue all Candace Owens public statements and shown evidence; evaluate the "no evidence" characterization against documented artifacts.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet states Wilson was paid for one day of debate training
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated on X that Andrew Wilson was paid for one day of debate training for TPUSA students and the campus debate team, denying he was being "paid" in a broader sense.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA payment records or 1099 documentation for Andrew Wilson.

claims.label: Blake Neff recommends Wilson's Rogan appearance
claims.claim: Blake Neff posted on X recommending Andrew Wilson's Joe Rogan appearance, stating Wilson "does a great job" dissecting conspiracy theories and answering Rogan's questions.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Nef's TPUSA affiliation and prior amplification patterns.

claims.label: Andrew Wilson debate clip displays verbal insults and personal attacks
claims.claim: A displayed debate clip shows Andrew Wilson, debating a female opponent named Charlie, using personal insults including calling her "stupid" and denigrating her family.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full unedited debate recording to verify context and whether insults were reciprocated.

claims.label: Host Says Lance Twiggs Snowboarding Photo Shows Left-Hand Landing
claims.claim: The host says a snowboarding photo she displays shows Lance Twiggs falling onto his left hand, which she says is consistent with left-handedness or ambidexterity.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain additional Lance Twiggs photos/videos showing hand dominance across varied activities.

claims.label: Host Says Lance Twiggs Fuels with Left Hand in Texas Photo
claims.claim: The host says a photo she displays shows Lance Twiggs fueling a vehicle with his left hand at a Texas gas station.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify photo metadata for date and location; obtain corroborating photos of Twigs using right hand to identify dominant hand definitively.

claims.label: Host Says Lance Twiggs Childhood Piano Video Shows Watch on Right Hand and Left-Hand Page Turn
claims.claim: The host says a childhood piano recital video of Lance Twiggs ("My name is Lance Twiggs. I am playing country concert for young pianists") shows him wearing a watch on his right hand and turning the page with his left hand.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm watch-hand convention and whether left-hand page turn is consistent with dominant left-handedness or training.

claims.label: Benny Johnson states public has seen 1–2% of available evidence
claims.claim: In a clip from The Benny Johnson Show, Benny Johnson stated that the public has seen only 1–2% of the physically available evidence in the Kirk case.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain disclosure schedule from prosecution; identify what evidence remains sealed vs. available but unreleased.

claims.label: Host Says UVU Staircase Maroon-Shirt Person Used Left Hand for Phone and Left Pocket
claims.claim: The host says blurry UVU staircase footage shows the maroon-shirt person holding a phone in their left hand and pocketing it in their left pocket.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the "4K" influencer-shown version of this footage for higher-resolution verification of hand usage and pocket side.

claims.label: Matt Walsh posted that grocery prices are "insane" and rising
claims.claim: Matt Walsh posted on X that grocery prices are insane and still rising, calling it the number one priority for elected leaders.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference BLS food-at-home CPI data for verification.

claims.label: Joel Barry posted that burritos for 8 cost under $20
claims.claim: Joel Barry posted on X that his wife's homemade burritos for a family of eight cost less than $20 total.
claims.investigative_direction: Request itemized receipt or recipe cost breakdown.

claims.label: Joel Barry in 2024 tweeted desire to return to affordable grocery era
claims.claim: Joel Barry tweeted in 2024, in reply to Kamala Harris, that he would like to "go back to when there were no wars and I could afford groceries."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify original tweet date and context.

claims.label: Per Post the Host Reads, Matt Walsh Told Joel Barry Republicans Were Inconsistent on Affordability
claims.claim: Per a post the host reads, Matt Walsh replied to Joel Barry noting that virtually no Republican was making "the affordability crisis is fake" arguments during the Biden years, and that grocery prices have risen 30%+ this decade.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile post history of named Republicans regarding affordability claims during 2021–2024 vs. 2025–2026.

claims.label: Dan Crenshaw posted "eat ramen" response to affordability concerns
claims.claim: Dan Crenshaw posted on X telling critics of grocery prices to "stop whining, get a job, eat ramen like the rest of us did in college."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify post and current ramen retail prices for college affordability comparison.

claims.label: Per Post the Host Reads, Blake Neff Shared WEF Chart Claiming US Spends Least on Food
claims.claim: Per a post on X the host reads, Blake Neff shared a World Economic Forum chart claiming Americans spend less of their income on food than any other country on the planet.
claims.investigative_direction: Community note referenced (cited pre-2020 data); obtain updated USDA ERS data for current expenditure share comparison.

claims.label: Host Plays Daily Wire Trailer That Ben Shapiro Introduced as Telling the Story of Radical Islam
claims.claim: Per a post on X the host reads, Ben Shapiro introduced a Daily Wire film trailer saying Hollywood has refused to tell the story of radical Islam for three decades; in the trailer the host plays, dialogue refers to Islam conquering the West "through immigration, through the wombs of our women, and by using our nation's freedoms against us."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify release date, distribution, and producer credits.

claims.label: Rabbi Shmuley Iceland video shows couple confronting him about Israel
claims.claim: A video posted by Rabbi Shmuley shows a couple in Iceland confronting him with statements about Israel after initially approaching as fans.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify participants' identities and location.

claims.label: Email describes Luna as hellhound character popular in furry fandom
claims.claim: A viewer email to the tip line describes "Luna" from the animated series Helluva Boss as an anthropomorphic hellhound character who is popular within the furry fandom and online animation communities, characterized as guarded, socially awkward, and emotionally withdrawn.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Helluva Boss character profile and Luna's first appearance date.

claims.label: Email states Luna wears pentagram necklace
claims.claim: Per the same email, the Luna character from Helluva Boss wears a pentagram as a necklace.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain canonical Helluva Boss images showing Luna's necklace design.

claims.label: Wikipedia describes Helluva Boss as following "Immediate Murder Professionals"
claims.claim: Per the Wikipedia page the host reads, the Helluva Boss animated series follows the employees of IMP (Immediate Murder Professionals), an assassination company in hell that offers hitman services in the living world.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Wikipedia entry at time of access; check edit history.

claims.label: Host Says Tip Line Received Tip on Non-Native English Author
claims.claim: The host says that the day before, her tip line received a tip about her insistence that the person who wrote the Tyler Robinson text messages was not a native English speaker.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the tip-line email and the forensic-linguistics basis for the non-native-speaker hypothesis about the disputed texts.
claims.transcript_snippet: we received a tip on our tip line regarding my insistence that the person who wrote those Tyler Robinson text messages was not a native English speaker.

claims.label: Host Says a French Detective Dog Term Literally Means Sniffer Pooch
claims.claim: The host says she looked up how the French describe a detective dog and found a word that literally translates to "sniffer pooch", which she takes as support for the French-translation hypothesis.
claims.investigative_direction: Check a French dictionary for the term the host means (rendered as "herl" in the transcript; see Doubts) and test whether it maps to "sniffer pooch".
claims.transcript_snippet: the way that they describe a canine, a detective dog, would be a herl, which literally translates into a sniffer pooch.

claims.label: Host Says Brigitte Macron Still Cannot Be Tracked on the Days of the Egyptian Planes
claims.claim: In a sarcastic aside, the host says Brigitte Macron's whereabouts are still missing for the days the Egyptian planes were in America and that she cannot track her.
claims.investigative_direction: Treat as a recap of the host's earlier Macron schedule-gap research; verify against the Brigitte Macron September 4-10, 2025 schedule record and the Egyptian aircraft tracking data.
claims.transcript_snippet: you're still missing those days. Days the Egyptian planes were in America. We still cannot track Brigitte.

claims.label: Host Says Episode Is Named for New Information on Lance the 4K Influencers Did Not Share
claims.claim: The host says the episode is titled Silence of the Lance because her team found interesting information about Lance and a tidbit that the 4K and HD courtroom influencers did not share with the public about what they saw.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify which influencers saw the 4K footage and obtain their accounts of what it showed.
claims.transcript_snippet: we came across some very interesting information about him and an interesting tidbit that the 4K influencers, the HD courtroom influencers, actually didn't share with the public about what they saw.

claims.label: Host Says Whatever Podcast Host Brian Atlas Offered 50K Then About 150K for Her to Debate Wilson
claims.claim: The host says Brian Atlas, host of the Whatever podcast, contacted her PR representative Mitchell with an offer of 50K for her to debate Andrew Wilson and then raised it, she thinks to 150K initially.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the offer messages between Atlas and the host's PR representative and ask Atlas who proposed and who funded the amounts.
claims.transcript_snippet: a guy named Brian Atlas, reached out to my PR guy, Mitchell, with an offer of 50K for me to debate this person. And then he upped the amount, I think, to 150K initially.

claims.label: Host Says She Dismissed the Debate Offer and Had Never Heard of Wilson
claims.claim: The host says she immediately dismissed the offer, had never heard the name Andrew Wilson, and assumed it was a PR ploy by a rising influencer buying exposure.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with Wilson's account on the Rogan show of how the offer was made and whether the host responded.
claims.transcript_snippet: I immediately dismissed it. I I genuinely had never heard of the name Andrew Wilson before.

claims.label: Host Says She Has Asked Only for a Public Discussion With TPUSA, Not Money
claims.claim: The host says her side has not asked for money, only for a public discussion about the case with Turning Point USA or an affiliate such as Blake Neff, Andrew Kolvet, Erika Kirk, Frank Turek or someone who was on the scene.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect the host's earlier public invitations to TPUSA figures and any replies.
claims.transcript_snippet: We have not been asking for money, just a public discussion with Turning Point USA, one of their affiliates regarding the case

claims.label: Host Says She Has Offered TPUSA the Floor Repeatedly
claims.claim: The host says she has offered the Turning Point USA people the floor repeatedly.
claims.investigative_direction: List dated invitations from the host to TPUSA figures and any declines.
claims.transcript_snippet: We've offered them the floor repeatedly.

claims.label: Host Says Wilson Is Affiliated With TPUSA and Boosted by Its Orbit
claims.claim: The host says she had not appreciated until clips circulated that Andrew Wilson is sort of affiliated with Turning Point USA, another person in their orbit they are boosting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA's description of Wilson's role and any payment or contract records for the debate training.
claims.transcript_snippet: he is sort of affiliated with Turning Point USA. another person in their orbit that they're boosting.

claims.label: Rogan Says It Would Have Been Better for Erika Kirk to Lay Low and Calls the Sparklers a Bad Idea
claims.claim: In the Rogan clip, Joe Rogan says that given the reaction it probably would have been better for Erika Kirk to lay low for a while and that going out with the sparklers was not a great idea because it seemed insane.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Rogan episode and confirm the exchange, and identify the sparkler event Rogan means.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think it probably would have been better for her to like lay low for a little while.

claims.label: Host Says Wilson Has a Manosphere Presence Debating Feminists
claims.claim: The host says that, as far as she can tell, Andrew Wilson had a presence in the manosphere debating feminists, which explains his appearances on the Whatever podcast.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Wilson's Whatever podcast appearances and his debate record.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew Wilson apparently had a presence in the manosphere uh debating feminists.

claims.label: Host Says Wilson Looks to Be About 50
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Wilson looks to be about 50 years old, the best she could do in finding his age.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Wilson's age from a public record.
claims.transcript_snippet: Now, Andrew Wilson looks to be about 50 years old.

claims.label: Host Says Wilson Is Trending on X for Lying to Rogan
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Wilson was trending on X for having lied to Joe Rogan throughout the interview and that the comments mocked him.
claims.investigative_direction: Capture the X trending data and the specific statements critics called false.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew Wilson currently trending on X, by the way, uh for having lied to Joe Rogan throughout this entire interview.

claims.label: Host Says Wilson Tied Her to a Leftist Tour She Has Never Spoken To
claims.claim: The host says Wilson tried to portray her as tangential to a leftist tour (rendered "unf America" in the transcript), which she says she has never so much as spoken to, and that he also lied about the tour's organizers.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Wilson's exact words on the Rogan show about the tour and identify the tour by name.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've never so much as spoken to them, but then he also lied about them.

claims.label: Host Says Wilson Accused the Tour of Money Laundering on Rogan Without a Fact Check
claims.claim: The host says Wilson accused the tour's organizers of laundering money on Joe Rogan's platform without any fact check.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Rogan segment and check whether any evidence was offered for the money-laundering accusation.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's accusing them of like laundering money and doing this on Joe Rogan's platform absent any fact check.

claims.label: Host Counter-Offers 500K to Wilson
claims.claim: The host says Wilson offered 300K and she counters with 500K for the debate.
claims.investigative_direction: Record whether Wilson or TPUSA responds to the 500K counter-offer.
claims.transcript_snippet: Uh he says 300K. Let's make it 500K, right?

claims.label: Host Has a Hunch TPUSA or Affiliates Are Backing Wilson's Debate Request
claims.claim: The host says she has a hunch, a gut instinct, that Wilson is backed by Turning Point USA or its affiliates in the debate request because he does not strike her as someone with 300K lying around.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Wilson and TPUSA who funds the 300K offer and obtain any payment records between TPUSA and Wilson.
claims.transcript_snippet: I just have the hunch, this feeling, gut instinct that you're maybe being backed by Turning Point USA or their affiliates in this debate request.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Raised 40 Million in One Night and Encased Charlie's Bloody Microphone at the Fundraiser
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA raised $40 million in one night, literally encasing Charlie Kirk's bloody microphone at a fundraiser so that his widow could be filmed standing next to it.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the fundraiser, obtain event footage showing the encased microphone and TPUSA's reported total.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point USA has raised $40 million in one night off of Charlie's blood, literally encasing his bloody microphone at a fundraiser event

claims.label: Host Says She Is Seven Months Pregnant and Wilson Must Travel to Her
claims.claim: The host states as a debate term that she is seven months pregnant, so Wilson would have to travel to her for a face-to-face debate.
claims.investigative_direction: None needed beyond the host's own announced terms; record the venue if a debate is ever scheduled.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm seven months pregnant. So, if you fancy a debate face to face, you're going to have to travel to me.

claims.label: Host Offers Live Debate With No Time Limit and Live Fact-Checking by Her Team
claims.claim: The host says the debate would have no time limit, would be live, and her team would bring up any documents or evidence Wilson mentions and pause so he can search for his own.
claims.investigative_direction: Record the final agreed format if a debate is arranged.
claims.transcript_snippet: No time limit in the debates, don't worry. It will be live. We will bring up any documents or evidence that you mention as a part of this case.

claims.label: Host Bans Chain-Smoking at the Debate
claims.claim: The host says Wilson will not be chain smoking around her and must leave his cigarettes at home.
claims.investigative_direction: None; stated debate condition.
claims.transcript_snippet: you're not going to be chain smoking around me, tough guy.

claims.label: Host Requires Nef, Kolvet or Erika Kirk to Publicly Claim Wilson First
claims.claim: The host says her key condition is that Blake Neff, Andrew Kolvet or Erika Kirk must publicly claim Wilson first, saying they are sending him to debate on their behalf about the Charlie Kirk case.
claims.investigative_direction: Watch for public statements from Neff, Kolvet or Erika Kirk claiming or disavowing Wilson.
